dyn-default-boom.speaker: vanguard
dyn-default-boom.text: Fire on the line! Seal the site. Nobody leaves.

dyn-default-cargo.speaker: handler
dyn-default-cargo.text: That's one. Carry what you can and get to the extraction zone.

dyn-default-charge.speaker: handler
dyn-default-charge.text: Charge set. One more, then we light it.

dyn-default-exfil.speaker: handler
dyn-default-exfil.text: Extraction is inbound. Hold the zone until it lands.

dyn-default-exfil-broken.speaker: handler
dyn-default-exfil-broken.text: You've left the zone. They won't wait for you. Get back in.

handler-boss-enrage.speaker: handler
handler-boss-enrage.text: Almost done. This is when they are worst. Finish it.

handler-boss-escalate.speaker: handler
handler-boss-escalate.text: He's hurt and he knows it. He'll stop being careful now.

handler-first-contact.speaker: handler
handler-first-contact.text: Contact. They know you're here now. Move.

handler-low-ammo.speaker: handler
handler-low-ammo.text: You're nearly dry. Take what the guards drop.

handler-low-hp.speaker: handler
handler-low-hp.text: You're hit. Get behind something. The cargo isn't going anywhere.

handler-op-breach.speaker: handler
handler-op-breach.text: You're in. Escort's awake now, so make it quick.

handler-op-start.speaker: handler
handler-op-start.text: Contract's live. The cargo is in the yard past the hall. Load it, walk it out, get paid.

handler-push-in.speaker: handler
handler-push-in.text: That's the yard. Get on the cargo and start loading. They will try to take it back.

handler-reinforce.speaker: handler
handler-reinforce.text: More guards are coming in. Finish up.

handler-troops-cleared.speaker: handler
handler-troops-cleared.text: Forward escort is down. Someone just keyed in on the convoy channel.

handler-zone-clear.speaker: handler
handler-zone-clear.text: Hear that? They just raised the price of the next job.

reinforce-1.speaker: handler
reinforce-1.text: One more guard coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-10.speaker: handler
reinforce-10.text: 10 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-11.speaker: handler
reinforce-11.text: 11 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-12.speaker: handler
reinforce-12.text: 12 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-2.speaker: handler
reinforce-2.text: 2 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-3.speaker: handler
reinforce-3.text: 3 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-4.speaker: handler
reinforce-4.text: 4 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-5.speaker: handler
reinforce-5.text: 5 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-6.speaker: handler
reinforce-6.text: 6 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-7.speaker: handler
reinforce-7.text: 7 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-8.speaker: handler
reinforce-8.text: 8 more guards coming in. Finish up.

reinforce-9.speaker: handler
reinforce-9.text: 9 more guards coming in. Finish up.

vanguard-finale.speaker: vanguard
vanguard-finale.text: Every crate you carry out, we pay for twice. Remember that when the next convoy rolls.

vanguard-first-word.speaker: vanguard
vanguard-first-word.text: This is Vanguard. That cargo is accounted for. You will be too.

vanguard-hero-down.speaker: vanguard
vanguard-hero-down.text: Raider down. Recover the cargo and log the bounty as unpaid.

vanguard-zone-clear.speaker: vanguard
vanguard-zone-clear.text: Convoy commander lost. Doubling escorts on every route out of the depot.

vex-mission-cleared.speaker: vex
vex-mission-cleared.text: Lovely. Bring it round to the exchange. I'll have the credits ready, as agreed.
